# E0211: unknown name

Check the spelling. A local is visible after its `let`, and an item of another module is named through it, as `fs.exists` after `use std.fs`.

- Rule: [`declarations.unknown-names`](../../reference/10-declarations.md#declarations.unknown-names)
- Reported at: the name that doesn't resolve.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example 1

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0211:1
fn average(count: i64, sum: i64) -> i64 { sum / cuont }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn average(count: i64, sum: i64) -> i64 { sum / count }
```

## Example 2

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0211:1
fn first(xs: List<i64>) -> Option<i64> { if xs.is_empty() { null } else { Some(xs[0]) } }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn first(xs: List<i64>) -> Option<i64> { if xs.is_empty() { None } else { Some(xs[0]) } }
```

`stilt check` on [`E0211_append_function.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0211_append_function.lt):

```text
── UNKNOWN NAME ────────────────────────── E0211_append_function.lt:3:8  [E0211]

Stilt has no `append` function: a list grows with a method, as `xs.push(x)`:

  3 │   xs = append(xs, 2)
    │        ^^^^^^

`push` adds an element at the end of a list that a `var` holds, and changes it
in place.

To fix it, call the method `push`:

  3 │   xs.push(2)
    │   ~~~~~~~~~~
```

`stilt check` on [`E0211_python_range.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0211_python_range.lt):

```text
── UNKNOWN NAME ──────────────────────────── E0211_python_range.lt:2:12  [E0211]

Stilt has no `range`: a `for` goes through a range, as `for i in 0..n`:

  2 │   for i in range(3) {
    │            ^^^^^

`0..n` counts from 0 up to `n`, leaving `n` out, and `0..=n` counts to `n` too.
A range is written only as what a `for` goes through.

To fix it, write a range:

  2 │   for i in 0..3 {
    │            ~~~~
```
